[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided examples including Community-Based Participatory Research (CBPR) in Chicago reducing secondhand smoke exposure.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned Health Equity Impact Assessment (HEIA) used in a public transportation project in Toronto to address health inequities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cited Inclusive Technology Development (ITD) for affordable hearing aids in low-and-middle-income countries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Discussed the Return of Research Results practice ensuring participants receive findings from genetic research.  
[USER] Inquired about challenges researchers face in implementing equitable strategies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed challenges including limited funding for tailored research, power imbalances between researchers and communities, and limited understanding of marginalized communities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned limited engagement with policymakers and resistance to change as additional challenges.  
[USER] Asked about consequences researchers face for failing to implement equitable strategies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained potential consequences including damage to reputation, reduced funding opportunities, and limited impact of research.
